cases.title: Verify Navbar Toggler Functionality on Small Screens
cases.description: Load the page on a small screen where the navigation menu is initially collapsed. Click the navbar toggler button (data-testid="navbar-toggler") and verify that the navigation menu (data-testid="navbarSupportedContent") expands to show menu items. Click the toggler button again and verify that the menu collapses.

cases.title: Add Book Validation - Empty Fields
cases.description: Leave either the 'User Name' (data-testid="user-name-input") or 'Book Name' (data-testid="book-name-input") field empty in 'my-library-form' and click the 'Add Book' button (data-testid="add-book-button"). Verify that an error alert with the message "Oops! Book is not issued" is displayed.

cases.title: Add Book Validation - Duplicate Book Name
cases.description: Attempt to add a book whose name has already been issued to another user by filling out 'my-library-form' and clicking 'Add Book'. Verify that an error alert with the message "Oops! Book is already issued by [issuedUser]" is displayed.

cases.title: Add Book Success and Persistence
cases.description: Fill out valid inputs in 'my-library-form', select a book type via radio buttons, and click 'Add Book'. Verify that a success alert with the message "Success Book is issued" appears, the entry is added to the table, and the data is correctly persisted in local storage.

cases.title: Delete Book Entry from Table and Storage
cases.description: Click the delete button associated with a specific book entry in the table (identified by data-id matching 'delete-button-{index}'). Verify that the book is permanently removed from the display, updated in local storage, and the table is re-rendered.

cases.title: Load and Render Stored Books from Local Storage
cases.description: Pre-populate local storage with a JSON string under the 'listItems' key containing book objects. Load the webpage and verify that the books are correctly parsed and rendered with full details inside the table body element (data-testid="table-body").

opinions.feedback: All high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly aligned with the requirements without any blockers.
All test cases map correctly to their respective requirements and are verifiable.

analysis.analysis:
Requirement e2edev_bench_08-R-1: Testable behavior includes verifying the initial collapsed state of the navigation menu on small screens and toggle functionality via `data-testid="navbar-toggler"` to show/hide `data-testid="navbarSupportedContent"`. Boundaries: small screen vs. large screen. Normal path: click toggler to expand, click again to collapse. Abnormal path: none explicitly defined. Ambiguity: exact window width threshold for small screens not specified.

Requirement e2edev_bench_08-R-3: Testable behavior includes adding a book via `my-library-form` with fields `user-name-input`, `book-name-input`, and radio buttons (`fiction-radio`, `programming-radio`, `cooking-radio`), and clicking `add-book-button`. Boundaries: empty fields vs. filled fields, unique vs. duplicate book names, normal vs. long strings. Normal path: valid inputs add entry, show success alert "Success Book is issued", and persist to local storage. Abnormal paths: empty fields show error alert "Oops! Book is not issued"; duplicate book issued to another user shows error alert "Oops! Book is already issued by [issuedUser]". Ambiguity: handling of whitespace-only strings for text inputs.

Requirement e2edev_bench_08-R-4: Testable behavior includes clicking `delete-button-{index}` to remove a specific book entry. Boundaries: deleting first, middle, or last index items. Normal path: book is removed from display, local storage, and table is re-rendered. Abnormal path: attempting to delete with invalid or out-of-bounds index. Ambiguity: index updates after deletion.

Requirement e2edev_bench_08-R-5: Testable behavior includes loading stored books from local storage under the `listItems` key and rendering them in `data-testid="table-body"`. Boundaries: empty local storage vs. populated local storage. Normal path: JSON array parsed and displayed with serial number, date of issue, reader's name, book name, and genre. Abnormal path: malformed JSON string in local storage. Ambiguity: exact format of the date of issue field.
